title: (Gen's) Builders Delight
description: A creative building modpack full of optimizations and performance mods, as well as a few QOL changes and better world generation.
body:
This is a modpack that I put together on modrinth, I take no ownership, I am uploading this for my YT channel to see and use if they so desire.

  This modpack Is full up optimization mods, performance mods, Quality of Life mods, and World Gen mods-like tectonic and terralith. Designed to make the game run smooth with high FPS and look Amazing.

  I am also using Voxy for the first time in this pack as opposed to Distant Horizons, Once I messed with the settings for a good long while I got it running way better than DH could ever dream of. I am using Complementary shaders Becaause Photon shaders is not compatable with Voxy!

  Anyway please enjoy, again I take no ownership, each mod in this pack is owned by somone other than this guy :p
